_meta.note: Captured off the wire, and it is what ACP_BACKENDS_SESSION_MCP_ARRAY membership rests on: a stdio MCP mount COMPLETING a round trip, not merely being accepted. session/new was sent one element shaped as mcp_gateway.session_servers._acp_server_entry emits a pooled broker stub -- name, command, args, env -- pointing at a real minimal stdio MCP server. It returned a sessionId, and the server's own log shows the harness called initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list AND tools/call on it. The frames here carry the resulting tool_call, whose title is the harness's own MCP grammar mcp__<serverName>__<toolName>, and the tool_call_update carrying the server's marker text. So its initialize advertising mcpCapabilities {http: true} names only ACP v1's OPTIONAL transports and stdio is the baseline it serves. Note also what is ABSENT: no session/request_permission for this tool call either. REDUCED from the capture: the session/new config options are pruned because they named the provider route the recording host had configured, and the session id is a fixed synthetic one.
